definitions.explanation: In Japanese historiography, the period roughly from the late 16th century through the mid-19th century, corresponding to the Azuchi-Momoyama and Edo periods. In Western historiography, the early modern period generally spans from the Renaissance to the Industrial Revolution.

examples.japanese: {近世|きんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鎖国|さこく}→鎖国：14514_sakoku⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とった。
examples.english: Early modern Japan adopted a policy of national isolation.

examples.japanese: {近世|きんせい}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{松尾芭蕉|まつおばしょう}→松尾芭蕉：30772_matsuobashou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。

examples.japanese: {近世|きんせい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{移行期|いこうき}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらした→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: The transition from the early modern to the modern period brought great changes to society.

notes:
{近世|きんせい} is a historical periodization term. In Japanese history, it refers specifically to the Azuchi-Momoyama period (1568-1600) and the Edo period (1600-1868).

Japanese historical periodization:
- ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧ (ancient period)
- ⟦{中世|ちゅうせい}→中世：05524_chuusei⟧ (medieval period)
- {近世|きんせい} (early modern period)
- ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧ (modern period — Meiji onward)
- ⟦{現代|げんだい}→現代：02722_gendai⟧ (contemporary period — post-WWII)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {近世|きんせい}⟦{文学|ぶんがく}→文学：01505_bungaku⟧ (early modern literature)
- {近世|きんせい}⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧ (early modern history)
- {近世|きんせい}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (early modern society)

Not to be confused with ⟦{近代|きんだい}→近代：02663_kindai⟧ (modern period), which in Japanese usage typically begins with the Meiji Restoration (1868).
